subject: dify
positioning: Open-source LLM app development platform — visual workflow canvas, RAG pipeline, agent capabilities (ReAct/function-calling), model management, LLMOps, BaaS.

language_stack.backend: Python Flask (DDD/Clean Architecture), Celery + Redis, SQLAlchemy, pytest

differentiators_observable: Community scale: 30+ README translations (en, zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, es, fr, de, it, ko, pt-BR, klingon, hindi, bangla, slovenian, vietnamese, turkish, arabic)
Visual workflow canvas (AI workflows on drag-and-drop canvas)
50+ built-in tools (Google Search, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, WolframAlpha)
Model providers: hundreds of proprietary/open LLMs (GPT, Mistral, Llama3, OpenAI-compatible)
LLMOps: logs, performance analytics, prompt/dataset/model improvement
Observability nativo: Opik, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix integrados
BaaS — every feature tem API correspondente
Deployment: Docker Compose, Kubernetes (5+ community Helm charts), Terraform (Azure/GCP), AWS CDK (EKS/ECS), Alibaba Cloud one-click
LFX Health Score, LFX Contributors badges (Linux Foundation Insights)
